name: save-boot-3-walk-barret-md1stin
description: #99 attempt 2 (diagnostic): boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-barret-md1stin.json (md1stin, field ID 0x74 per ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID; triangle 12, x 0x7FFF so the game places the player at the triangle's centroid, as #38 did; progress 6 as at md1stin; party [1, 0, 255]: Barret leads, Cloud second), loaded as save-boot-1-load does.
